Package robbery.keys

Class Keys

java.lang.Object
robbery.keys.Keys
public class Keys extends Object
Represents a store key in the Robbery plugin.

Each key has a store name, base price, order, and a colored display name. The price can be modified by a player's prestige boost using PlayerData.
